text:
maria: kicking off NRT edge cluster onboarding — want a short ops checklist focused on perf/validation before we hand this to SRE tomorrow. target: 8x A10s, p95 < 85ms for small-gen workloads, steady throughput at 600 tokens/s aggregate. please review what I have and flag gaps.
aj: quick q — are we bringing up with the stock NVIDIA driver (525) or the vendor-provided 535? driver choice affects kernel module checks.
maria: vendor 535 will be used for this run. we chose it for NVLink improvements. also want kernel 6.1.x to match other regions.
devin: noted. I'll run the kernel/driver verification checklist. rough plan: 1) verify modinfo/nvidia-smi 2) run nvlink sanity 3) run micro-bench p95 tool 4) network MTU + RDMA check 5) large-batch throughput sweep.
shaun: add a quick test for page migration/NUMA — last time we saw big tail issues when containers landed on cross-socket memory. simple: run 2x pinned processes with numactl and compare p95.
kai: I'll validate kernel modules and driver versions and post exact commands. also will capture dmesg for any UVM/driver warnings.
provision-bot: nodegroup "nrt-edge-3" created: 8 nodes, 1:1 GPU:node, image: redwood-2026-03-08-venv, kernel: 6.1.15, driver: nvidia-535.12. logs at https://infra.redwood/internal/nrt-edge-3/provision/2100456789
maria: thanks. operational acceptance criteria (OAC) proposal: - kernel/driver matching across all nodes - nvlink bandwidth within 5% of reference - p95 latency for small-gen (prompt len 32, temp=0.0) < 85ms - throughput plateau at expected batch sizing within 10% of model perf baseline - no >1% error rate on request outcomes - end-to-end RTT from edge LB to container p95 < 120ms
aj: cost callout — if we need sustained 8x A10s per region it's ~x1.9 cost vs c5-style instances for CPU-heavy routes. can we share a perf/cost trade doc during the run?
devin: adding to checklist: capture per-token GPU util, PCIe throughput, and collect nv-hostengine stats. I'll include a command blob we can paste into the runbook.
shaun: sample commands for kernel/driver verification:```bash
ssh node-01
sudo modinfo nvidia | egrep 'version|parm'
nvidia-smi -q -d PERFORMANCE,DRIVER
sudo dmesg | tail -n 200 | egrep -i 'UVM|NVRM|nvlink|error|warn'
```
shaun: and NVLink check:```bash
nvidia-smi nvlink --status
# or run nvlink_bandwidth_test from diag image
```
kai: network checks: validate MTU 9000, run iperf3 between two GPU nodes pinned to same AZ, and run RDMA pingpong for IB. also confirm that cloud NIC driver is the expected release.
maria: good. timeline — baseline runs today 16:00-18:00 UTC, validation window 18:30-20:00 UTC for soak, handoff doc to SRE by 21:00. can people confirm availability?
aj: I can join baseline at 16:00 and stay for the soak.
devin: oncall swap means I can cover 16:00-19:00 then kai takes over for soak.
kai: yep i'll cover 19:00-21:30 for soak and handoff notes.
shaun: I'll be on standby for NUMA regression troubleshooting during baseline.
maria: final quick additions: capture a small eval prompt set (shared link) to ensure quality parity, and snapshot AMI + provisioning manifest into the run metadata. I'll draft the handoff section in the run doc. Link: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/nrt-onboard (WIP). :white_check_mark:
provision-bot: validation-queue: job 9876 scheduled for 2026-03-18T16:05:00Z (baseline runs). logs will post to the above provision link.
maria: awesome, thanks everyone — please drop any additional tests here before 15:30 UTC so I can fold them into the runbook. :thumbsup:
